findings.text: RULE-ra-07 and the plan (technical decision: dates by the local calendar in shared/domain/followUp.ts) make the reevaluation a calendar-day rule: due date = local day of the latest diagnosis + 90 days, late once that day has passed. The consultant home used an instant rule (more than 90*24h). The portfolio service now uses followUp.reevaluationOf for both the home and the PDF, so `overdue[].daysSince` counts calendar days and the line moves from '90 days plus 1 second' to 'the day after day 90'. The IF-007 shape, the ordering and every other list are unchanged; 30 of the 32 original home tests passed untouched, and the 2 that pinned the sub-day line ('keeps the line at the ninetieth day, strictly' and 'moves with the clock') were rewritten to the day line (90 days on time, 91 late), plus a new local-midnight test. QA should confirm this reading of 'tela do consultor igual'.

server/validation/reportSchemas.ts is outside this unit's allowed files and its reportSelectionSchema has no `portfolio` kind, so POST /api/reports/export and GET /api/reports/preview still answer 400 validation_failed for {kind:'portfolio'} even though reportService now builds and saves it. The service accepts a local `ReportRequest = ReportSelection | PortfolioSelection`, so it type-checks before and after the schema change.

server/app.ts creates createReportService({ prisma, downloadsDir }) without `now` or `rules`, so the portfolio PDF counts days with the real clock while the consultant home uses deps.now. In production both are the same clock; in API or e2e tests with an injected clock the PDF would not match the home. The unit's own API test builds the service with now: db.now.

drawTable (server/report/pdfBlocks.ts, phase 1) gives the first column 60% of the width and splits the rest among the others, so a table with 4 or more columns cuts dates mid-digit. The active-company list therefore has three columns: Empresa | Estágio e último diagnóstico | Atenção. Late reevaluation, high risk and, once tracked, overdue actions are words inside 'Atenção', not columns of their own. Overdue actions are simply absent while no row carries a count (overdueActions === null, the state until phase 3), as AC-ra-15 asks. A column per attribute would need drawTable and ReportTableBlock to take column widths.

The list is cut into A4 pages by an estimate of lines per cell (CHARS_PER_LINE [30, 15, 15], LIST_ROWS_BUDGET 560 pt). Probed against the real renderer: the worst cases (120 companies with 80-character names of capital M or W and nothing to flag) overflow only from a budget of about 640 pt, so the shipped 560 leaves roughly 75 pt (one to two rows) of margin. Five stress cases render without PageOverflowError in tests/unit/portfolioDocument.test.ts.

The evolution case of tests/unit/forbiddenTerms.test.ts, left to this unit by the evolution unit, is added: 4 evolution documents (same rules and recalculated, with and without 'O que foi feito no período') and 6 portfolio documents (empty, tracked and untracked actions, branded or not), each checked for the RULE-dm-14 terms and for the guidance warning in the summary and in 'Como ler'.

`pnpm exec playwright test tests/e2e/portfolioReport.spec.ts tests/e2e/home.spec.ts` (AC-ra-16 mode 'minha empresa' and empty portfolio, the 'portfolio-report' prototype interaction) was not run: it needs PortfolioReportPage.tsx, ConsultantHome.tsx, App.tsx and portfolioReport.spec.ts, which belong to the frontend unit phase-2-frontend-evolution-portfolio, and the portfolio kind in reportSchemas.ts (see the finding above).

`pnpm build` (tsc --noEmit && vite build) was not run in full: `pnpm exec tsc --noEmit` over src, server, shared and tests passes (exit 0), but the vite build half and the Play dev-link check (export the three PDFs and open them) belong to integration after the frontend units land.

messages.text: Add the portfolio kind to server/validation/reportSchemas.ts: `const portfolioSelectionSchema = z.object({ kind: z.literal('portfolio') })` and put it in the `reportSelectionSchema` discriminated union. createReportService already handles {kind:'portfolio'} for preview and export (document kind 'portfolio'; file carteira-{YYYY-MM-DD}.pdf; a generated_files row of kind 'portfolio_pdf' with companyId null; 409 `portfolio_empty` when no company is active). Once the union has the member, PortfolioSelection and ReportRequest in reportService.ts can be replaced by ReportSelection.

In server/app.ts pass the app clock and the rules to the report service: createReportService({ prisma: deps.prisma, downloadsDir: deps.downloadsDir, now: deps.now, rules }), so the portfolio PDF and the consultant home count days from the same clock.

Portfolio report over IF-001, after the schema member is added: GET /api/reports/preview?kind=portfolio returns a ReportDocument with kind 'portfolio' and pages cover / by-stage / companies-1..N / how-to-read (the list is a table with columns Empresa, Estágio e último diagnóstico, Atenção). POST /api/reports/export {kind:'portfolio'} returns {fileId, fileName, directory}. An empty portfolio answers 409 `portfolio_empty` (the page should show the empty state with 'Cadastrar a primeira empresa' before asking). The backend does not check the usage mode: the 'minha empresa' explanation is the page's job.

For the phases that extend the portfolio (phase 3 overdue actions, phase 5 interval and attention filters): portfolioService.read(at?) returns { reevaluationDays, view, rows }. `view` is IF-007 exactly; `rows` has one entry per active company (stage, lastDiagnosisAt, `reevaluation` from followUp.reevaluationOf, highRisk, overdueActions). overdueActions is null for every row now: phase 3 fills it in buildPortfolio (from portfolioRepository) and the PDF then shows the 'Ações vencidas' fact and 'N ações vencidas' in 'Atenção' by itself; phase 5 replaces OVERDUE_DIAGNOSIS_DAYS (= DEFAULT_REEVALUATION_DAYS) with the chosen interval. homeService still re-exports STALE_DRAFT_DAYS, OVERDUE_DIAGNOSIS_DAYS and the ConsultantHomeView, PortfolioCompany and StageGroup types, so existing imports keep working.
tests/helpers/testDatabase.ts resetData does not clear the generated_files table, so a test that counts saved files must compare against a count taken before it acts (the unit's API test does).
